## Featured Work & Case Studies

### 1. SmartCV Builders (Featured Product Case Study)
- **Role:** Solo Founder, Product Designer & Creator
- **Type:** Live Free SaaS Web Application
- **Problem Solved:** Most online resume builders force user signups, gate downloads behind unexpected paywalls, and store personal data.
- **Solution:** A 100% free, private, client-side resume builder with zero logins, no stored user data, instant live side-by-side preview, and pixel-perfect PDF export.
- **Key Metrics:** 44+ dynamic ATS-ready templates, global user adoption.

### 2. Clever Hoot Library (Brand & Character Mascot · Concept Design)
- **Client / Concept:** Brand identity and custom mascot for a modern library.
- **Concept & Metaphor:** The owl was selected because owls fly completely silently, tying directly to the library's quiet rule ("a hoot that makes no sound").
- **Visual Execution:**
  - Peeking pose with paws gripping the ledge (curious, watchful personality).
  - Swept-back feather tuft (adds energy and distinct recognizable silhouette).
  - Heavy, rounded typography stacked as "Clever" over "Hoot" matching outline weights.
- **Source Deliverables:** Vector artwork available via Adobe Illustrator file link.

### 3. Go Digital (Agency Brand Identity & Motion System · Concept Design)
- **Client:** Marketing & digital growth agency.
- **Concept:** Communicating "Go" at a glance before reading a single word.
- **Lettermark Construction:** The negative space inside the fresh mint "G" forms a golf club, and the sliced deep green "O" below it forms the ball.
- **Wordmark Typography:** Rounded geometric typeface with mint dots on the i's that echo the G.
- **Motion Animation Rationale:** Designed for animation so the mark is never static — the golf club swings, and the ball bounces playfully across the dots on the i's.
- **Source Deliverables:** Vector branding system available via Adobe Illustrator file link.
